text:
{
  "task_category": "code_explanation_architecture",
  "project": "01_SITE_MA_METHODE",
  "entrypoints": {
    "html": "index.html",
    "stylesheet": "src/styles.css",
    "module_script": "src/main.js"
  },
  "boot_sequence": [
    "buildStory",
    "bindContactForm",
    "bindProjectGrid",
    "prepareVideoForScroll",
    "initBootLoader"
  ],
  "lazy_modules": [
    {
      "module": "contact-scene.js",
      "loaded_by": "ensureContactScene",
      "trigger": "idle, scroll, or contact request",
      "role": "WebGL scene for contact form"
    },
    {
      "module": "project-registry.js",
      "loaded_by": "bindProjectGrid",
      "trigger": "project grid initialization",
      "role": "Project metadata and cards"
    }
  ],
  "contact_scene_api": [
    "setScrollProgress",
    "setPhase",
    "setHover",
    "explodeToForm",
    "showReceivedMessage"
  ],
  "registry_role": "Generated by the orchestrator, exports orchestratorProjectCards",
  "summary_fr": "Le projet demarre via index.html qui charge les styles et le script principal. Le boot sequence initialise la story, les formulaires, la grille de projets, la video et le loader. Les modules contact-scene.js et project-registry.js sont charges dynamiquement. Le premier gere la scene WebGL pour le formulaire de contact, declenchee par idle, scroll ou demande. Le second, genere par l'orchestrateur, fournit les metadonnees des projets pour la grille."
}
